data.text: Welcome, Luke! My family taught me to fish here, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village. I’d support 10 tons each this month—that’s $10,000 apiece while leaving enough fish for the lake to refill. A bigger share for one person would mean someone else agreeing to take less, not raising the 50-ton total. Let’s check catches together each month and adjust if the stock falls. John, does that sound fair to you?
